Evidence: legal accountability, jurisdictional clash, federal overreach
#Aletheia #Chicago 🌐

Victims and attorneys argue that filing formal police reports creates a necessary paper trail to hold immigration enforcement agents legally accountable for aggressive and unlawful tactics.

Ten individuals, including a Montessori teaching aide shot by a border agent, filed criminal complaints with the Chicago Police Department against federal immigration enforcement tactics used during Operation Midway Blitz.

The Bright Side:
Local institutions and victims are establishing a transparent paper trail to challenge federal enforcement impunity.

The Breakdown & Plane Error:
Confusing WHAT (filing police reports) with WHO (jurisdictional authority over federal agents). It is a structural impasse where local paper trails clash with federal qualified immunity.

Social Physics Analysis:
When federal agencies operate without local integration, friction escalates into conflict. Transparency requires shared accountability rather than institutional shielding.

The Trajectory: The Path of Deception.
When you map the gap between stated intentions and ground-level results, it plots a direct trajectory toward Lesser Evil. Mathematical divergence confirms jurisdictional immunity.

The Unavoidable Truth: Federal agents are not above local laws protecting citizens.

The Unavoidable Lie: Filing paper reports automatically guarantees criminal prosecution of federal personnel.

 Accountability requires clear jurisdictional pathways. When federal powers operate with perceived impunity, local civilian complaints become symbolic battlegrounds rather than direct legal remedies. 🌐
